_README: The details only you can supply. tools/make-legal.js reads this, fills every
[[PLACEHOLDER]] in legal/*.md and legal/ar/*.md, and writes six pages to assets/.
node tools/make-legal.js --check    what is still missing
node tools/make-legal.js --draft    preview with the gaps highlighted
node tools/make-legal.js            build for real (refuses while gaps remain)
"something"        an answer, published as written in both languages
{"en":..,"ar":..}  an answer that reads as prose, so it needs both
""                 NOBODY HAS ANSWERED YET — blocks the build
null               answered: publish nothing, and drop the line it sat on
null is not a weaker "". Use it for details you have decided not to publish.
Never type the words 'not registered' anywhere in this file: a published
document saying so is a dated, signed admission. Leaving the line out is
neutral. See legal/FILL-IN.md for what each entry is and why it matters.
The Arabic is the operative text by these documents' own choice, so an ar
value is not a translation of the en one — it is the version that binds.
_A: ═══ ONLY YOU CAN ANSWER THESE — the build is blocked until you do ═══
_A_note: OPERATOR LEGAL NAME — the full legal name that receives the money; your
national ID name if you are not incorporated. Put the Arabic spelling in
'ar' and the Latin one in 'en'. Appears in all six files.
OPERATOR ADDRESS — a real address for correspondence and service, written
the way each country's post would read it.
COURTS CITY — follows from your address. e.g. en 'Cairo', ar 'القاهرة'.
The three emails may all be the same mailbox. One you actually read.
EFFECTIVE DATE — the day you publish, as YYYY-MM-DD. It is also stamped on
every account and every payment as the version they accepted.
_B: ═══ DECISIONS — sensible answers already in place; change if you disagree ═══
_B_note: The four nulls above are the registration numbers and the phone line.
Set to null deliberately: the imprint drops those lines entirely rather
than publishing a blank label or a number that rings out. When you
register, put the numbers in and rebuild — that is the only change needed.
A phone line you will answer is worth adding: this audience expects one.
Give it as {"en": "+20 1x xxx xxxx", "ar": "٠١x xxx xxxx"}.
_reply_note: One number, five places, on purpose. One person with a phone cannot honour
four different clocks, and a deadline you miss is worse than a longer one
you keep. Raise all five together or none.
LIABILITY FLOOR is the bare number: the documents supply 'EGP' and
_C: ═══ ENFORCED BY CODE — test/retention.test.js fails if these drift ═══
_C_note: These are not prose. server/config.js RETAIN_IP, RETAIN_SUBMISSION,
RETAIN_SCREENSHOT and RETAIN_DORMANT are what server/retention.js deletes
on, and test/retention.test.js reads this file and fails if the published
number and the enforced one disagree. Change one, change both, or the
suite stops you — which is the whole reason a published retention period
here means something. A month is 30 days on both sides.
IP RETENTION is a floor as well as a ceiling: Anti-Cyber Crime Law 175/2018
obliges a service provider to retain data identifying its users for 180
days. Shortening it is not a privacy improvement. CONFIRM WITH A LAWYER
that S37 counts as a service provider for that purpose.
The two cookie lifetimes are config.js GUEST_TTL and BRAND_TTL. Shortening
GUEST_TTL is recommended (CODE-CHANGES S1) — a 365-day rolling identifier
weakens the 'strictly necessary' position in PRIVACY §12. Change both.

CPA CONTACT.ar: الخط الساخن ١٩٥٨٨، أو cpa.gov.eg، أو info@cpa.gov.eg

DATA PROTECTION CENTRE CONTACT.en: the Personal Data Protection Centre at the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, pdpc.gov.eg
DATA PROTECTION CENTRE CONTACT.ar: مركز حماية البيانات الشخصية التابع لوزارة الاتصالات وتكنولوجيا المعلومات، pdpc.gov.eg

_D_note: TAX RECORD RETENTION — commonly cited as 5 years; confirm with an accountant.
It appears in REFUNDS §1 and PRIVACY §7.2/§9 and is what turns 'we keep
payment records indefinitely' into 'the law requires us to'.
BREACH DEADLINE — the PDPL notification deadline, commonly cited as 72 hours.
CPA CONTACT — verified live 2026-08-17: hotline 19588, cpa.gov.eg carries a
working complaints page, info@cpa.gov.eg. A WhatsApp line (01281661880)
was also published; left out because it was not independently re-verified.
DATA PROTECTION CENTRE CONTACT — the Centre exists under MCIT and pdpc.gov.eg
resolves, but as of 2026-08-17 its portal was reported not yet operational.
Deliberately worded as who and where, promising no email and no form.
NOTE: the Executive Regulations landed 1 Nov 2025 (PM Decree 816/2025) with
a one-year grace period — full PDPL enforcement is expected October 2026.
_E: ═══ BACKUPS — describes what actually runs today ═══

BACKUP DESTINATION AND STATUS.en: We take copies of the database by hand. There is no automatic schedule, and no copy is stored outside our hosting provider.
BACKUP DESTINATION AND STATUS.ar: نأخذ نسخًا من قاعدة البيانات يدويًا. لا يوجد جدول تلقائي، ولا تُحفظ أي نسخة خارج مزوّد الاستضافة.

BACKUP RETENTION.en: we keep a hand-made copy only until the next one replaces it
BACKUP RETENTION.ar: نحتفظ بالنسخة اليدوية حتى تحل محلها النسخة التالية فقط

_E_note: This is the honest description of today, and it is a sentence you will not
want to leave up. Nothing automatic runs: deploy/s37-backup.timer is a
systemd unit from the VPS design and does not exist on Railway; the
Litestream keys in .env.production are blank; and tools/backup-nightly.js
writes into DATA_DIR/backup — the same volume as the database it copies.
When you fix it (CODE-CHANGES M9), rewrite both entries to name the
destination, the country and the retention — and rewrite them BEFORE
switching the destination on, not after. A new country has to appear in
PRIVACY §5 before any data starts going there.
